title: arthrobotrya articulata
intro: Arthrobotrya articulata, commonly known as the False Hoya, is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Arthrobotrya articulata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties.
